title: When the AI helper's answer fails to save, the owner never sees what the visitor was told
what: The AI helper first saves the visitor's question as waiting, then answers the visitor, then saves its answer on the chat. If that last save fails, the visitor has already read the AI's answer, but the owner's Enquiries shows the question as 'Needs you: the AI did not answer' with no AI words, so the owner may call to answer something already answered, or never learn what the AI said. When the AI itself fails and that save also fails, the visitor is told the question is saved for the gym, but no alert goes to the gym, because the alert is only made by the answer save. Only the server log knows.
expected: What the AI told the visitor, or that it could not answer, is always kept on the chat, and the gym is alerted whenever the visitor was told the gym will answer.
how_often: only when the gym server write fails after an answer
fix_line: Retry the answer save, and when it still fails, raise the 'could not answer' alert so the gym hears of the question.

title: Leaving a number in the AI helper makes a second enquiry for a person the gym already has
what: 'Ask the gym' adds a question to the open enquiry that already has the same number. The AI helper's 'leave your number' box does not look: it puts the number on the chat's own enquiry. So a visitor who first asks through the form (or is already an open enquiry at the desk) and then leaves the same number in the chat becomes two open enquiries, with two alerts to every staff member, and two people may call the same visitor.
expected: One person, one open enquiry: the chat's number joins the open enquiry that already has that number, and the staff get one alert.
how_often: whenever a visitor uses both the form and the chat
fix_line: When a number is left in the chat, look for an open enquiry with that number first and join the two.

title: A visitor who chats again after their enquiry was closed is filed under the closed enquiry and the bell calls it done
what: The AI helper keeps one enquiry per visitor browser. When the owner has closed that enquiry (marked lost or joined) and the visitor comes back with a new question, or now asks to join, the new messages are added to the closed enquiry, which stays closed. The staff get an alert saying to open Enquiries, but the bell treats any alert on a closed enquiry as already done, and the enquiry sits in the closed list, not on top with the chats that need the owner. The visitor was told the gym will call.
expected: A new question or a join request from the chat reopens the enquiry (or starts a new one), stays in the bell until handled, and shows on top in Enquiries.
how_often: every returning visitor whose enquiry was closed
fix_line: When a chat message lands on a closed enquiry, reopen it with today's follow-up date.
